title: Channels Only * /
firstLine: Composer; Ada R. Gibbs, 1910, arr. by R. J. Stevens

lines: Composer; Ada R. Gibbs, 1910, arr. by R. J. Stevens
Scripture; 2 Timothy 2:21
How I praise Thee, precious Savior,
That thy love laid hold of me;
Thou hast saved and cleansed and filled me
That I might thy channel be.
Emptied that Thou shouldest fill me,
A clean vessel in Thy hadn;
With no pow'r but as Thou givest
Graciously with each command.
Witnessing Thy pw'r to save me,
Setting free from self and sin;
Thou who bought me to possess me,
In Thy fullness, Lord, come in.
Jesus, fill now with Thy Spirit
Hearts that full surrender know;
That the streams of living water
From our inner man may flow.
Channels only, blessed master,
But with all Thy wondrous pow'r
Flowing through us, thou canst use us
Ev'ry day and ev'ry hour.
